{{Top|leg}}
The '''Synthax-7 voice synthesizer''' was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implant that allowed translation of [[Language/Legends|languages]]. The [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Greel]] used a Synthax-7 to translate [[Gamorrese]] into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
